meta_description: OpenStreetMap ke free naksa jon Kiwix me offline chale hai. Vector tile, satellite photo, 3D zameen aur Wikipedia ke jaankari — iOS, Android, Mac, Windows aur Linux pe bina internet ke chale hai.
tagline: OpenStreetMap ke naksa jon Kiwix me offline chale hai. Vector tile, satellite photo, 3D zameen aur Wikipedia — internet ke jaruri nahi hai.
maps_intro: Niche se ek region chuno, Kiwix install karo, aur .zim file kholo. Sab file Internet Archive pe rakha hai — har download ke saath torrent bhi hai.
maps_intro_lang: Niche se ek region chuno aur uske Fiji Baat me download karo: naksa ke naam, search aur Wikipedia Fiji Baat me hai. File ke Kiwix me kholo, ee ek free app hai; har naksa ke page batawe hai kaise karna hai, ek ek step.
feature_key_intro: Har card ke nisaan batawe hai andar ka hai:
badge_nav_desc: har mor pe raasta batawe hai, offline,
badge_overture_desc: Overture se website, phone number aur social media,
badge_photo_desc: koi board ke photo se jagah khojo.
what_lead: StreetZim OpenStreetMap ke data — pura des nahi to pura continent — ek ZIM file me band kare hai jon Kiwix me khul sake hai. Ee pura offline chale hai: koi server nahi, koi API nahi, aur pahila download ke baad internet ke jaruri nahi.
what_p2: Jaada offline naksa app raster tile use kare hai; StreetZim vector tile use kare hai jon tumhar device pe hi bane hai, MapLibre GL JS ke saath. Isse naksa aaram se khiske, zoom hoe aur ghume hai, aur 3D zameen bhi mile hai — sab kuch tumhar device ke ek hi file se.
feat_vector_p: Saaf aur smooth naksa sarak tak, OpenMapTiles schema ke saath, jon MapLibre turant banawe hai.
feat_sat_p: Bina baadal ke Sentinel-2 photo, 10 meter resolution, naksa ke pura area khatir.
feat_terrain_p: Pahaar ke chhaaya aur 3D uunchai, pura dunia ke Copernicus GLO-30 DEM se.
feat_wiki_p: Koi sahar, pahaar nahi to mashhur jagah pe dabao aur uske Wikipedia lekh aur khaas jaankari dekho.
feat_search_p: Lakhon jagah ke naam, sarak, park, pahaar ke choti, airport aur dusra jagah me khojo.
feat_offline_p: Khaali ek .zim file. Koi account nahi, koi tracking nahi, koi internet nahi. Kholo aur chalo.
step1_p: Ek free app iOS, Android, Mac, Windows aur Linux khatir. kiwix.org pe mile hai. Windows aur Linux pe abhi naksa ke Kiwix PWA me kholo: Kiwix Desktop 2.5 uske khaali dekhawe hai, aur iske fix abhi khaali nightly build me hai.
step2_p: Uppar se ek region chuno aur .zim file download karo (nahi to jaldi khatir torrent lo).
step2_p_lang: Uppar se ek region chuno aur uske download button dabao: tumme naksa Fiji Baat me mili, ek .zim file me.
step3_p: .zim file ke Kiwix me kholo. Bas itna hi — naksa pura offline chale hai.
sources_intro: StreetZim khaali open data se bana hai. Har naksa ZIM me ee source ke cheej hai:
src_map: Naksa ke data: © OpenStreetMap ke contributor log, Open Database License (ODbL) ke niche mile hai.
src_sat: Satellite photo: EOxCloudless https://cloudless.eox.at by EOX IT Services GmbH (Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2021) — CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, khaali bina business waala kaam khatir.
src_elev: Uunchai: Copernicus GLO-30 DEM — © DLR / Airbus, European Union aur ESA ke COPERNICUS program ke niche dewa gais hai.
src_place: Jagah ke jaankari: Wikidata (CC0) aur Wikipedia (CC BY-SA 4.0).
oss_intro: StreetZim .zim file khole khatir Kiwix ke app pe bharosa kare hai. Sab open source hai aur GitHub pe bane hai:
footer: StreetZim ek open source project hai. Source code GitHub pe hai. Naksa Internet Archive pe rakha hai.

card_languages_title: Ee naksa, naam aur Wikipedia dusra bhasa me, tumhar browser me jora jaae hai

card_no_lang: Abhi Fiji Baat me nahi hai: ee naksa me jagah ke naam huwan ke bhasa me hai aur interface English me hai.

mp_feat_nav: Paidal, cycle aur gaari ke raasta, jon tumhar device pe hi nikle hai.
mp_feat_overture: Dukaan, restaurant aur dusra jagah, uske website aur phone number ke saath.
mp_feat_wiki: Sahar, mashhur jagah aur ghume waala jagah ke Wikipedia lekh.
mp_feat_photo: Photo se khojo: koi board ke photo lo aur uu jagah ke naksa pe khojo.

mp_dl_original_note: Naksa jaise bana raha: jagah ke naam huwan ke bhasa me; interface aur Wikipedia English me.

kg_h2: Naksa ke Kiwix me kaise kholo
kg_android_1: Google Play se Kiwix install karo. Ee free hai.
kg_android_2: Uppar waala naksa download karo. Tumhar phone uske Downloads me rakhe hai.
kg_android_3: Kiwix kholo, uske library me jao aur download karal file joro.
kg_ios_1: App Store se Kiwix install karo. Ee free hai.
kg_ios_2: Uppar waala naksa download karo. Safari uske Files app me, Downloads ke niche rakhe hai.
kg_ios_3: Kiwix kholo, uske library me jao aur Downloads se file kholo.
kg_mac_1: Mac App Store se Kiwix install karo, phir download karal file usse kholo.
kg_pc_1: Apan browser me Kiwix web app kholo aur download karal file chuno. Kiwix Desktop 2.5 ee naksa ke khaali dekhawe hai; iske fix abhi khaali nightly build me hai.
kg_offline: Iske baad naksa bina internet ke chale hai.
hero_h1: Naksa jon bina internet ke chale hai
hero_apps: Free Kiwix app me khule hai:
tour_lead: Ee video me sab kuch device ke ek hi file se chale hai. Ee internet band kar ke record bhais hai; khaali caption aur har tap dekhae waala dot baad me jora gais hai.
tour_photo_h: Board ke photo lo, jagah khojo
tour_photo_p: Sarak ke board, dukaan ke saamne waala hissa nahi to hotel ke key card pe likha address ke photo lo, aur naksa uu jagah khoje hai jiske naam likha hai. Sabd tumhar device pe hi parha jaae hai, jon script me likha hai usi me: hian Ukrainian, Greek, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Chinese aur English hai, ek saath.
tour_photo_note: Jon naksa pe ee nisaan hai, usme.
tour_zoom_h: Pura sahar se ek ghar tak
tour_zoom_p: Vector naksa har zoom pe saaf rahe hai: pura Kyiv se ek ghar tak uro, phir naksa ke jhukao aur ghumao.
tour_drive_p: Kyiv ke aar paar ek raasta, jon phone pe nikla aur har mor pe follow bhais. Ee nakli location ke saath record bhais hai; safar ke beech waala hissa das guna tej chale hai.
tour_terrain_p: Pahaar ke chhaaya, 3D zameen aur satellite photo: Tehran ke uppar waala pahaar.
tour_signs_p: Wahi search har script me, uu sahar ke naksa pe jahan board laga hai.
tour_credits: Ee video aur screenshot me board ke photo, gate ke photo aur satellite photo dusra log ke kaam hai: photo ke credit aur license dekho.
gallery_lead: Naksa ke asli screen, computer aur phone pe. Ek chuno aur bada kar ke dekho, phir baaki dekhte jao.
gal_place: Jagah ke card, photo aur Wikipedia ke chhota jaankari ke saath
gal_find: Nagich ke cafe, dukaan aur dusra cheej khojo
gal_turns: Har mor ke raasta, list me
gal_photo: Photo se khojo ek board parhe hai
gal_photo_found: Jagah jiske naam board pe hai
langs_lead: Jagah ke naam, search, raasta batana, Wikipedia ke lekh aur naksa ke apan menu, uu bhasa me jon tum parho hai. Daahina se baayan likha jaae waala script bhi.
langs_step1_p: Niche ke list se chuno, nahi to har page ke uppar waala menu se.
langs_step2_h: Naksa uu bhasa me download karo
langs_step2_p: Tumhar bhasa ke page pe, har naksa ke main button uu naksa ke usi bhasa me download kare hai, ek .zim file me. Ee English page har naksa waise de hai jaise uu bana raha: jagah ke naam huwan ke bhasa me, interface aur Wikipedia English me.
langs_step2_p_lang: Ee page pe har naksa ke main button “Fiji Baat me download karo” hai: naksa, jagah ke naam, search, Wikipedia aur menu Fiji Baat me, ek .zim file me. Jab koi naksa abhi Fiji Baat me taiyaar nahi hai, tab uske card ee batawe hai.
langs_step3_p: Jaada naksa uu bhasa me ban sake hai jon huwan bola jaae hai, jaise Spain aur Portugal khatir Catalan, nahi to Britain aur Ireland khatir Welsh. Dusra bhasa me naksa har naksa ke sab bhasa dekhawe hai aur file ke tumhar browser me jore hai.
langs_demo_note: Kyiv ke wahi naksa Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi, Thai, Japanese aur Chinese me. Jab koi naam ke translation nahi hai, tab uu waise rahe hai jaise huwan likha jaae hai.
langs_grid_note: Number batawe hai ki aaj uu bhasa me kitna naksa taiyaar hai.
filter_none: Isse koi naksa nahi mila. Koi des, region nahi to sahar try karo.
credits_intro: Video aur screenshot naksa ke waise dekhawe hai jaise uu hai. Photo search waala board, ek mashhur jagah ke photo aur satellite photo dusra log ke kaam hai, aur ee license ke niche use bhais hai. Board ke photo crop karal hai.
